notes: printed is [RSSSF name, second source name] in the order of each season's sources array. pos is set only when both sources print the club at the same final position; otherwise posBySource gives [RSSSF position, second source position] (relegation play-offs, Calciopoli sanctions in 2005-06, tie-break differences). canon is the Soccer Career spelling from HAND_CLUBS in src/lib/soccerCareerEngine.ts (exact name match only; Lazio Roma and SS Lazio are not Roma, Chievo Verona and Hellas Verona are separate clubs and have canon null).
